feeds.title: The Birth Hour Blog
feeds.description: On The Birth Hour blog, listen to and read all types of birth stories from women all over the world. The blog has been featuring homebirths, cesareans, natural births, preemie births, and more. Follow this blog to read every type of birth story & info to get you started!

feeds.title: Home Sweet Homebirth Blog
feeds.description: Holistic midwife that offers services such as online childbirth course, yoga classes, consults, coaching and mentoring birth professionals, helps new midwifes start practice, newsletter, ebooks, webinars and offers information on natural birth, holistic midwifery, yoga, and your journey as a mother. Follow this blog and get information about supporting and empowering women in their childbearing years and beyond.

feeds.title: Orgasmic Birth
feeds.description: Our mission is to educate and inspire women and men to research and understand their options to create a safe, satisfying and pleasurable birth. Follow this blog to discover what's attainable from giving birth naturally as seven women and their partners share their most intimate moments.

feeds.title: Lamaze International » Giving Birth With Confidence
feeds.description: Giving Birth with Confidence is a comprehensive blog by Lamaze International that aims to empower expecting parents with evidence-based information on pregnancy, childbirth, and early parenting. Authored by a dedicated team, the blog ensures parents feel supported and confident throughout their journey. Lamaze International, a globally recognized non-profit, advocates for safe and healthy birthing practices. The editorial team includes experienced professionals who contribute valuable insights and practical advice to guide parents through their unique experiences.

feeds.title: Hypnobirthing Australia Blog
feeds.description: Hypnobirthing Australia by Melissa Spilsted teaches hypnobirthing techniques to parents and practitioners throughout Australia and the world. The Hypnobirthing Australia program is a unique and comprehensive antenatal education program that uses deep relaxation, self-hypnosis and specific breathing techniques for a safer, easier and gentle birth.

feeds.title: Gather Birth Cooperative Blog
feeds.description: Gather Birth Cooperative is a team of award-winning birth professionals who provide evidence-based birth support, birth photography, lactation support, & more to families in Minnesota. Our mission is to stand as a bold & passionate presence in the Minnesota birth community, creating outstanding artistic content & offering holistic educational resources & services that address the many phases of parenthood while maintaining a joyful, collaborative partnership that honors each member's individuality & talents.

feeds.title: Fear Free Childbirth Blog
feeds.description: Helping you to prepare for a fear free birth. Alexia's Fear Free Childbirth podcast can help you to have a stress-free pregnancy and prepare for a fear free childbirth and positive birth experience.

feeds.title: Carolina Birth and Wellness Blog
feeds.description: Carolina Birth and Wellness offers total Wellness Support for families with birth doula services, massage therapy, and infant massage classes.

feeds.title: Bright Heart Birth Services Blog
feeds.description: Proudly supporting people and their families with Childbirth Education and Birth Doula Support for natural birth, medicated birth, epidural birth, high risk, cesarean birth, vbac, homebirth or hospital birth.

feeds.title: Mother Rising Blog
feeds.description: Mother Rising is a pregnancy blog for new moms covering everything from pregnancy, and childbirth, to postpartum. Here you will find helpful posts about infertility, pregnancy, birth, postpartum, breastfeeding, mothering, self-care, natural remedies and so much more.

feeds.title: Natural Birth and Baby Care Blog
feeds.description: Get the latest news on the benefits of natural birth, preparing for labor, having a great pregnancy, and bring up a healthy baby. Follow this blog to discover critical information on what really works to prepare you for natural childbirth (and some tips about what doesn't), so you can go from start to finish on your baby's birthday, naturally.

feeds.title: The Positive Birth Movement
feeds.description: Global network of free to attend antenatal discussion groups, aiming to improve birth. We aim to challenge the current epidemic of negativity around childbirth by bringing women together. Follow this blog to get information on improving childbirth.

feeds.title: Edel Immersys Blog
feeds.description: Edel Immersys is a leading supplier of water birth pools that are designed to create an intimate and peaceful birthing experience. Subscribe to our blog and stay up-to-date with the latest news and updates from the water birth industry, and the Edel Immersys team.

feeds.title: Better Birth Blog
feeds.description: Information & Inspiration for Pregnancy, Birth & Parenting. Hi! Welcome to Better Birth Blog, where I share information and inspiration for the childbearing year as well as love and help for breech babies. I offer evidence-based, hands-on birth classes in Maryland and online.

feeds.title: Giving Birth Naturally
feeds.description: Giving Birth Naturally publishes evidence-based childbirth education articles, online childbirth classes, natural childbirth videos and resources for each woman giving birth.

feeds.title: Saudi Birth Story
feeds.description: Sharing my passion for natural birth with others in Saudi Arabia and around the world! I am a midwife, childbirth educator, lecturer, doula, and natural mother of eight children.

feeds.title: My Natural Baby Birth
feeds.description: Essentials for joyful expectations. Helping devoted mothers prepare for the natural baby births that they desire, so they can give the gift of a healthy life for their babies without added stress. Follow this site to get answers you need to make this natural baby birth possible.

feeds.title: Andaluz Waterbirth Center Blog
feeds.description: Andaluz Waterbirth Center upholds the rights of healthy women to birth their baby where and how they choose and provides an environment which is safe and sensitive to do so.
